body:
> Hi, I noticed that ASVS 5.0 points to https://owasp.org/www-community/Application_Threat_Modeling as the 2nd reference on page 118. Can I request that be updated to https://owasp.org/www-project-threat-model/ ?

From Adam Shostack here:
https://owasp.slack.com/archives/C06MNF14M/p1762695739592259

comments.body:
Hi! I’d like to work on this issue.
I noticed that the ASVS 5.0 reference link on page 118 (Appendix D) still points to the old URL:
https://owasp.org/www-community/Application_Threat_Modeling

I plan to update it to the correct one:
https://owasp.org/www-project-threat-model/

I’ll make sure to apply this fix across all ASVS 5.0 language versions (en, tr, ru, fr).
Could you please assign this issue to me? 😊

Is it a bug? What is the difference between those two projects? And should it be fixed in the source if one project replaces the other?

https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/pull/3289#issuecomment-3520356476

> Is it a bug? What is the difference between those two projects? And should it be fixed in the source if one project replaces the other?
> 
> [#3289 (comment)](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/pull/3289#issuecomment-3520356476)

It isn’t a bug in the translation — the Turkish text just follows the English source. Right now the English source links to both the Threat Modeling Cheat Sheet and the OWASP Threat Modeling project page. They cover almost the same content, so if one is replacing the other then the English source should be updated (and the web pages merged/redirected). I’m happy to update the translation once the English source picks the canonical link.

Thanks for picking this up @Shreyas-Madake,

I discussed with @elarlang. Regarding the link change, the www-community resources are all a little out of date and at the same time I know they are trying to revive the threat modeling project.

Regarding the translation question, I agree that this should only apply to the english version, the translations should be static as at the v5.0.0 release, please revert the changes to the translations @Shreyas-Madake.

> Thanks for picking this up [@Shreyas-Madake](https://github.com/Shreyas-Madake),
> 
> I discussed with [@elarlang](https://github.com/elarlang). Regarding the link change, the www-community resources are all a little out of date and at the same time I know they are trying to revive the threat modeling project.
> 
> Regarding the translation question, I agree that this should only apply to the english version, the translations should be static as at the v5.0.0 release, please revert the changes to the translations [@Shreyas-Madake](https://github.com/Shreyas-Madake).


Thanks for the guidance! I’ve reverted the Turkish/Russian/French files to match the v5.0.0 release and left the English link change in place. Let me know if there’s a preferred canonical URL once the site updates—I’m happy to adjust the English file again if needed.
